# eatRecode

## Overview

`eatRecode` (educational assessment tools: Recode) is a tool to
standardize and ease recurring recoding tasks.

## Installation

``` r

# Install development version from GitHub via
remotes::install_github("beckerbenj/eatRecode")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`checkRecodeList()`](https://beckerbenj.github.io/eatRecode/reference/checkRecodeList.md)
  : Check Recode List
- [`createRecodeDB()`](https://beckerbenj.github.io/eatRecode/reference/createRecodeDB.md)
  : Create Recode Data Base
- [`extractManualRecode()`](https://beckerbenj.github.io/eatRecode/reference/extractManualRecode.md)
  : Get manual recodes
- [`getRecodeDB()`](https://beckerbenj.github.io/eatRecode/reference/getRecodeDB.md)
  : Get Recode Data Base
- [`getRecodeList()`](https://beckerbenj.github.io/eatRecode/reference/getRecodeList.md)
  : Get Recode List
- [`namesRecodeDB()`](https://beckerbenj.github.io/eatRecode/reference/namesRecodeDB.md)
  : Get Names of Recode Data Base
- [`updateRecodeDB()`](https://beckerbenj.github.io/eatRecode/reference/updateRecodeDB.md)
  : Update Recode Data Base
- [`useRecodeList()`](https://beckerbenj.github.io/eatRecode/reference/useRecodeList.md)
  : Use Recode List
